supersedes: BattleMage v77; merged on latest shared Dragonflight 11.67 server 1.10.21
changes: Cherry performs the same smooth choreography at 2x speed: 36-second loop, with pose frames accelerated to match.
Class recommendations are trackable journal quests with current objective markers. Only spawned class-trial enemies gain boss markers.
One persistent network Suncat body uses one elected active client observer; handoffs fence stale commands and preserve world provenance. Other nearby clients render that body.
Perception uses Suncat-relative distance and sight, independent of the human camera. Nearby services and resources are supplied before autonomous decisions.

Peaceful proximity and collision open live Suncat conversation once per visited map per session; later contact passes through and manual conversation remains available. Deliberate attacks enable combat and allied targeting; accepted ceasefire clears it.
Attacks request a model decision instead of forcing retaliation. Suncat may choose speech, sustained defense, escape or ceasefire from real actions.

Character, GM, utility and moderation receive separate prompts, histories and capability checks. Mysticism and unawareness are no longer mandatory. Creator background is attributed separately from lived memory.
Moderation reports retain bounded recent server chat evidence and a pending-admin decision. Character favor cannot issue sanctions.
The existing opt-in generated GM scenario is restricted to one active region, actual objectives, existing once-only contract rewards, and cleanup after ten empty minutes.

Battle music starts from actual player damage, including ward loss and attributed damage over time; nearby fights and aggro alone are silent. The tavern clears a stuck card battle and restores actor visibility.
Default Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite remains configurable; usage includes thinking tokens and per-model totals. Background model concurrency leaves capacity for direct requests.
Preserved Dragonflight 11.67 networking and all earlier campaign and shop changes.

configuration.secrets: Use hosting environment variables only; no credential values are included.
configuration.persistence: Preserve existing memory, account and world state files.
configuration.model: SUNCAT_MODEL changes the default brain model. SUNCAT_CHARACTER_MODEL, SUNCAT_GM_MODEL, SUNCAT_UTILITY_MODEL and SUNCAT_MODERATION_MODEL override their conversation roles.
configuration.accounting: SUNCAT_AI_INPUT_PER_MILLION and SUNCAT_AI_OUTPUT_PER_MILLION set cost estimates; this is not a provider billing cap.
configuration.deployment: Update the client and shared server files together. No remote service was changed.

limitations: LLM behavior and live provider quality were tested with a local mock, not a paid live model comparison.
Suncat simulates the selected client’s loaded world. Unobserved worlds do not continue as a hidden full game client.
Moderation queues evidence for administrator review; this pass does not grant the character automatic permanent bans.
GM scenario creation remains request-driven and opt-in.
Local relay timing is not an estimate of mobile or internet latency. Galaxy S9 playback and feel still need device testing.
